Self.Wiki: Hitset: a build-time marker named after a collision model (hitset_hAABBCCNN). Usually one tile-sized 512 m box per open-world tile, with smaller boxes for sub-collisions. The game never reads it, so editing it changes nothing in-game. 1,076 regions in retail, all in m60/m61.

UnkT00.Wiki: An ID from -1 to about 150, shared by the sub-boxes of one collision and roughly sequential across neighbouring tiles. Never read by the game; its meaning is not known.
